boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a versioned commercial-pursuit aggregate spanning a lead signal to an explicitly qualified opportunity. Party, customer, account, campaign, product, offering, activity, communication, quote, order, contract, fulfilment, forecast, finance and records masters remain external.

decisions.rationale: One pursuit can bind signal, need, qualification, fit, stage, stakeholders, value, forecast and outcome evidence without absorbing adjacent identity, communication, commercial or financial masters.
The unified registry supplies a parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-026 edge. It grants no containment or cascade authority.

decisions.concept: Signal, party, lead, customer, account and opportunity
decisions.rationale: A signal may be anonymous, a party is not a qualified lead, and neither a lead nor opportunity proves customer or account status. Conversion records lineage.
Expressed and inferred needs remain distinguishable and contestable, while offerings and specifications remain external versioned catalogue records.

decisions.concept: Qualification, score, stage, probability and forecast
decisions.rationale: Each axis carries its own method, version, evidence, authority, confidence and as-of time. None is promoted to objective fact or allowed to prove another.
Budget and estimated value are typed estimates and never substitute for price, quote, order, contract, recognized revenue or cash.
The pursuit binds roles and external activity references. It cannot autonomously contact a person, create consent, send a message or mutate calendar and communication masters.
GDPR, ePrivacy and FTC guidance are scoped profiles. Purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection and channel permission remain separate and no sensitive-attribute inference is permitted.
Lifecycle changes preserve prior identities, source evidence, reasons, authority and clocks rather than overwriting history or cascading into adjacent masters.
TM Forum, UBL, Schema.org, privacy, ORG, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI cover different facets and never replace the canonical pursuit aggregate.
The official URL path and visible release labelling are inconsistent; the mapping stays provisional until a release-specific artefact and conformance suite are pinned.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-ORG-014 parent signal and register pursuit relations to party, account, campaign, offering, activity, quote, order, contract, fulfilment, forecast and finance models.
Create business-to-business, consumer, public-sector, partner, marketplace, tender, subscription, fundraising, recruitment and regulated-sector pursuit profiles.
Benchmark and conformance-test organization-specific qualification, stage, scoring, probability, forecast and value methods including calibration and bias controls.
Validate channel, jurisdiction, consent, objection, profiling, competition, tender, contracting, privacy, retention and records policies.
Pin exact TMF699 and adjacent TM Forum release artefacts and validate mappings against concrete implementations.
Obtain independent external research, sales operations, privacy, legal, finance and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-026 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ORG-014 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-026 edge.
Identity hold: lead signal, known party, qualified lead, customer or account and opportunity remain distinct and conversion preserves lineage.
Methodology hold: qualification dimensions, stages, scores, probabilities and forecast categories require organization-specific definitions, versioning, calibration and review.
Bias and profiling hold: score and propensity features require purpose, lawful basis, minimization, fairness, explanation, contestability and prohibited-attribute controls.
Commercial boundary hold: estimated value, budget, offer, list price, quote, order, contract, forecast, recognized revenue and cash remain distinct.
Communication hold: purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection and channel permission remain separate; agents cannot autonomously contact or create consent.
Jurisdiction hold: GDPR, ePrivacy and FTC CAN-SPAM are scoped profiles; national, sector, consumer, employment, competition, tender and records rules need validation.
TMF699 source hold: the official URL path and visible release labelling are inconsistent, so the mapping requires release-specific confirmation.
State-axis hold: qualification, score, stage, probability, forecast category, expected close, actual close and outcome states and clocks must not collapse.
Authority hold: merge, conversion, stage change, contact, quote, order, contract, forecast commitment, disclosure and destruction require delegated authority.
Interoperability hold: every TMF, UBL, Schema.org, privacy, ORG, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
